name: diag_look_g01_black_retry_mapping_01
command:
import pathlib,json,re,importlib.util
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
r=pathlib.Path.cwd();guard,guard_ref=audited_result(r/'results/diag_look_g01_black_retry_guard_01.json')
assert guard['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and guard['metrics']['command_exit_code']==0
records=[]
for old,new,name in [('708054.hopper-m-02','708121.hopper-m-02','pilot_pairs_v2_look_table_b01_retry1'),('708092.hopper-m-02','708126.hopper-m-02','gen_train_metadata_revalidate_01_retry1')]:
 folder,=list((r/'logs/pbs').glob(name+'-*'));p=json.loads((folder/'payload.json').read_text());s=json.loads((folder/'submission.json').read_text())
 assert p['retry_of']==old and p['requested_gpu_count']==1 and p['requested_host'] is None and p['queue']=='autox' and s['returncode']==0 and s['stdout'].strip()==new
 records.append({'old_job':old,'new_job':new,'name':name,'receipt':str(folder.relative_to(r)),'wall_seconds':p['requested_wall_seconds']})
c,cr=audited_result(r/'results/t02_look_table_c01.json');assert c['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and c['metrics']['cleanup_errors']==[] and c['metrics']['errors']==[] and c['metrics']['unstarted_pair_ids']==[]
assert [(x['pair_id'],x['status']) for x in c['metrics']['pairs']]==[('floorplan203_00104','exported'),('floorplan203_00114','rejected'),('floorplan203_00116','exported')]
for x in c['metrics']['pairs']:
 if x['status']=='exported':assert x['table_complete'] and x['native_evidence_verified'] and x['pair_checks_passed']
 else:assert x['rejection_reasons']==['non_anchor_divergent']
account={}
for n in ('diag_look_census_b_black_accounting_01','diag_g01_metadata_black_accounting_01','diag_look_census_c_accounting_01'):
 d,ref=audited_result(r/'results'/f'{n}.json');assert d['_meta']['exit_code']==0
 account[n]={'reference':ref,'metrics':d['metrics']}
mod=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('phase',r/'scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py');phase=importlib.util.module_from_spec(mod);mod.loader.exec_module(phase);b=phase.budget_state(r)
assert b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['T01v2']<=16 and b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget']['G01']<=20 and b['accounted_or_reserved_total']<=60
note='\n### Native black-gate retries and completed census C\n\n'
note+='B708054 and G01708092 stopped before any science work on hopper-19 / GPU-41b4dc5b-ab2e-9066-f4b6-13baa1b17eac. Original terminal PBS86, exact immutable commands, nested result chains, allocation/node/UUID, original SHA-bound full-zero PNGs and clean worker/gate/parent shutdown all passed the logged one-off guard diag_look_g01_black_retry_guard_01. No synthetic payload or renamed evidence was supplied to a checker. Identical work with fresh run names and explicit retry_of mapping: '+json.dumps(records,sort_keys=True)+'. Original failures remain.\n\n'
note+='C708071 completed all3 diagnostics: floorplan203_00104 and00116 exported complete native-verified tables with original pair checks passed;00114 rejected non_anchor_divergent. Cache checks are still not run and no training use is authorized. Combined observed A/C plus the original E2E failure:9 triggers,2 complete without trigger,6 B proposals pending hardware retry; fixed census denominator17. Final association-authenticated report pending B.\n\n'
note+='Canonical actual usage and queue waits: '+json.dumps({k:v['metrics'] for k,v in account.items()},sort_keys=True)+'. Accounted-or-reserved chargedGPUh: '+json.dumps(b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],sort_keys=True)+'; shared '+str(b['accounted_or_reserved_total'])+'/60.\n'
with (r/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write(note)
print('BLACK_RETRY_MAPPING: '+json.dumps({'mapping':records,'guard':guard_ref,'c_result':cr,'accounting':account,'budget':b['accounted_or_reserved_by_subbudget'],'shared':b['accounted_or_reserved_total']},sort_keys=True))
